title: The first boss.
note: Tuning: inland cleared so the open route has straights (the Stag charges x2.5 after 4 straight tiles); 14 Thornwalls bend it; it walks the whole route from 2.5 s and is dispelled 3-4 cells from the Heartwood at 26-27 s (dry run, 002d04c6).
captions: The first boss: the Hollow Stag.
On a straight line, it charges.
So bend the maze. Every corner breaks the charge.
Dispelled on the doorstep. Too close.
